title: Existence of a left adjoint to the pullback of a morphism of topoi

difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a left adjoint for the pullback of a morphism of topoi under two hypotheses: that the values of the pullback on a chosen family of objects are represented by sheaves, functorially, and that every object has a covering by members of that family (statement lines 5266-5279). The proof is a complete construction: Yoneda produces the representing sheaves and exhibits the given bijection as composition with a canonical map, from which the author defines the functor on representables (proof lines 5282-5309); the definition is extended to coproducts of representables (proof lines 5312-5322); and an arbitrary sheaf is presented as a coequalizer of such coproducts, on which the functor is defined by the induced coequalizer, with the adjunction verified by a chain of identifications of morphism sets (proof lines 5324-5371). The non-formal content is the definition on representables and the adjunction verification. The claim is H2: a construction carried out in three stages with every input named.
